```
import { attachConfigurableFreeControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

// Key aliases help both event.key and event.code based implementations.
const UP_KEYS = ["Space", " ", "space", "Spacebar"] as const;
const DOWN_KEYS = ["PageDown", "pagedown"] as const;
const FAST_KEYS = ["Shift", "shift", "ShiftLeft", "ShiftRight", "shiftleft", "shiftright"] as const;

export function attachFlyControls(
  camera: FreeCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
): () => void {
  return attachConfigurableFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene, {
    upKeys: UP_KEYS,
    downKeys: DOWN_KEYS,
    fastKeys: FAST_KEYS,
    fastMultiplier: 3,
  });
}
```
